This '''unidentified Imperial soldier''' was stationed at an [[Imperial Relay Outpost V-798|Imperial outpost]] on [[Vaal/Legends|Vaal]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Stationed on Vaal for several months, he and the others grew lazy, and preferred to slack instead of working. Along with [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Reybn]], he told [[Privitt]] that nobody would care if he didn't do what he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to do. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he witnessed [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] entering the outpost with a pack of aggressive [[hyenax]] and taking the outpost's only [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]].
